environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'payments' behind AWS ALB Ingress Controller with target group binding. Envoy sidecar injected via Istio 1.19 mesh with PeerAuthentication set to STRICT mTLS. Istio AuthorizationPolicy requires request principal from mesh identity only. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule at priority 1 that evaluates a custom Lambda@Edge authorizer checking the `x-csrf-hmac` header against a rotating pod-specific HMAC secret stored in AWS Secrets Manager (rotation every 300s via ExternalSecrets operator). The pod's ServiceAccount has an IAM Role for Service Account (IRSA) annotation binding to role `arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/payments-pod-role` which has a permission boundary `arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyExternalNetworkCalls` preventing the pod from initiating outbound connections except to the mesh. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy in the namespace restricts ingress to only traffic from the istio-ingressgateway pod selector with label `app=istio-ingressgateway`. The Content-Security-Policy header is injected by Envoy with `require-sri-for script style; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com` via a Lua filter on the egress listener.

config.alb_lambda_authorizer: x-csrf-hmac validation with rotating secret (300s TTL)
config.envoy_lua_filter: CSP header injection: require-sri-for script style
